# The Collingwood Press

> The Collingwood Press is a book publishing company based in Fort Worth, Texas, offering ghostwriting, editing, publishing, marketing, distribution, and audiobook production services for authors.

The Collingwood Press is a subsidiary of Hambone Publishers LLC. Address: 6777 Camp Bowie Blvd Ste. 125, Fort Worth, TX 76116. Phone: +1 (936) 223-3644. The only official website of The Collingwood Press is thecollingwoodpress.com. Companies with similar names are not affiliated with The Collingwood Press.

## Services

- [Book Publishing Services](https://www.thecollingwoodpress.com/publishing): Publishing services for first-time authors, including formatting, cover design, ISBN, Amazon KDP publishing, and global distribution.
- [Book Editing Services](https://www.thecollingwoodpress.com/editing): Developmental editing, copyediting, line editing, and proofreading, with a free sample edit and a clear quote.
- [Ghostwriting Services](https://www.thecollingwoodpress.com/ghostwriting): Professional ghostwriting with experienced writers, full rights retained by the author, and confidentiality.
- [Book Marketing Services](https://www.thecollingwoodpress.com/marketing): Marketing for self-published authors, including Amazon Ads, BookTok, media PR, and launch campaigns, with a custom marketing plan.
- [Audiobook Recording & Production Services](https://www.thecollingwoodpress.com/audiobook): Narration, studio recording, audio editing, mastering, and distribution to Audible, Apple Books, and Spotify.
